rows.title: 2026-10-15 | Delivery gates, independent handoffs and platform plan
rows.text:
2026-10-15 | Delivery gates, independent handoffs and platform plan

Completed: automatic preflight/output checks for all six internal v1 stages, fresh attempts, fixed input snapshots, exact predecessor/hash records, stale-result blocking and a read-only recheck CLI. The independent synthetic demonstration passed six stages across five folders on one host; tampering with upstream motion blocked the consumer before execution. The recorded CPU allowlist passed 453 tests at commit 8fabd16; these are existing engineering checks, not new model results. The v2 foundation adds immutable storage, structural contracts and geometry helpers.

The native split preserves Human 01-04, Object 05 and Physics 06-07 dependencies. The platform plan prioritizes one complete native import/scene/export/reload path, then a two-host rehearsal, then baseline/candidate comparisons. Roles float across modules; execution and review participants are recorded per task.

Pending: real model adapters, native conversion, verified transport, quality acceptance and official export/reload. Registered reconstruction backends remain fake; no new real baseline or official score was produced. Next: obtain one permitted native sample, implement typed import and scene normalization, and verify a complete episode through export/reload.

Submit platform records at deliveries/platform/<unique-delivery-id>/README.md through a PR to main. Large outputs go to a new result-specific Release or agreed storage with exact hashes. This review index is not native package transport.

Evidence: docs/delivery-gates.md; docs/evidence/delivery-gates-validation-20261015.json (8fabd16); docs/platform-plan.md (78403e4). Current requirements remain docs/track1-requirements.md, R1-R6; Track 1 only.

rows.title: 2026-10-15 | Human contracts and handoff boundaries ready for adapter work
rows.text:
2026-10-15 | Human contracts and handoff boundaries ready for adapter work

Completed shared support: internal human deliveries are checked for complete frame coverage, required finite arrays, positive depth scale and valid upstream dependencies. The opt-in v2 foundation separately checks declared native-human shapes and rig/decoder bindings; it does not decode or convert MHR. The native design distinguishes early human/depth bootstrap from formal 01-04 preparation, which requires the exact metric object asset.

Pending: native adapters, receiving-machine import, conversion/reload verification and real body/hand quality review. These infrastructure changes produced no new real-model reconstruction or quality acceptance. Roles float: participants are recorded per task, with no permanent module owner required.

Next: obtain a permitted real bootstrap/native sample, implement its typed adapter, and verify original-frame mapping and scale consistency with the object and platform consumers. Do not treat the bootstrap as the final human trajectory.

Submit at deliveries/human/<unique-delivery-id>/README.md through a PR to main. Include exact upstream identities, native representation, full frame mapping, checks and missing products. Large native outputs use a new result-specific Release or agreed storage with exact hashes.

Evidence: docs/v2-foundation.md (2a5fbbc); docs/delivery-gates.md (8fabd16); docs/team-handoffs.md (ad17316). Current requirements remain R1-R6; Track 1 only.

rows.title: 2026-10-15 | Mesh, trajectory and dependency checks implemented
rows.text:
2026-10-15 | Mesh, trajectory and dependency checks implemented

Completed shared support: internal delivery gates reload meshes and records, check finite geometry and positive scale, and validate every frame's rigid pose and confidence range. Changed upstream results invalidate dependent deliveries. The v2 foundation adds structural mesh-pose-canonical-frame/scale bindings and episode-local source declarations. Passing these checks on synthetic fixtures does not establish correct reconstruction.

The native design permits unscaled asset preparation alongside human bootstrap, then metric asset delivery before formal 01-04 preparation and native 05 tracking. Typed native adapters, cross-machine import and real tracking/quality review remain pending. No new real tracking result or quality acceptance was produced. Roles float across tasks.

Next: deliver one explicitly scaled asset and a native 05 sample with exact upstream identities; verify complete original-frame coverage, mesh/origin consistency and occlusion failures with the receiving stages.

Submit at deliveries/object/<unique-delivery-id>/README.md through a PR to main. Distinguish an unscaled candidate, metric asset and tracking result. Large meshes/trajectories use a new result-specific Release or agreed storage with exact hashes.

Evidence: docs/v2-foundation.md (2a5fbbc); docs/distributed-execution.md (ad17316); docs/evidence/delivery-gates-validation-20261015.json (8fabd16). Current requirements remain R1-R6; Track 1 only.

rows.title: 2026-10-15 | Bounded-repair contracts and checked refinement handoffs
rows.text:
2026-10-15 | Bounded-repair contracts and checked refinement handoffs

Completed shared support: the opt-in v2 foundation validates declared repair plans, including affected entities/frames, mutable and fixed variables, fit/review partitions, budgets and the exact rollback scene. Registered orientation/contact/occlusion operation names are not implemented solvers. Internal gates require both refined human and object outputs and reject missing or stale dependencies; the registered refine backend still passes inputs through.

The native split defines a coherent-input boundary for 06-07 joint inference/post-optimization and keeps research candidates separate from a frozen baseline. Native adapters, transport, empirical acceptance thresholds and real improvement evidence remain pending. No new real quality improvement was established. Participants may change between tasks.

Next: build an independently authored synthetic repair/ablation harness, then compare a bounded candidate against the same real baseline when available. Record motion timing/amplitude, contact effects, failure intervals, regressions and rollback. Self-smoothness alone is not official ACC improvement.

Submit at deliveries/physics/<unique-delivery-id>/README.md through a PR to main. Bind the baseline and observations, state permitted changes, and preserve separate candidate outputs. Large artifacts use a new result-specific Release or agreed storage with exact hashes.

Evidence: docs/v2-foundation.md (2a5fbbc); docs/team-handoffs.md (ad17316); docs/platform-plan.md (78403e4). Current requirements remain R1-R6; Track 1 only.
